customer: My order hasn't arrived yet. Can you check the delivery status?
resolution: Ask for the order number and check the shipment status. If tracking is available, share the latest status.
brand_reply: Sorry about the delay. Please send us your order number by DM so we can check the delivery status for you.

customer: Where is my package? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
resolution: Ask for the order number and check the shipment status.
brand_reply: Sorry it's late. Please DM us your order number and we'll check the latest delivery update.

customer: I want my money back for this order.
resolution: Ask for the order number and verify refund eligibility before promising a refund.
brand_reply: We're sorry this didn't work out. Please DM us your order number and we'll look into the refund options.

customer: Can I get a refund? The item wasn't what I expected.
resolution: Collect order details and verify the applicable refund process.
brand_reply: We can look into that for you. Please send your order number by DM so we can check the available refund options.

customer: My payment failed but my card was charged.
resolution: Do not promise a reversal. Collect transaction/order details and verify the payment status.
brand_reply: Sorry about that. Please DM us your order or transaction details so we can check the payment status.

customer: The checkout says payment failed every time.
resolution: Ask the customer to retry using supported payment methods or provide transaction details for investigation.
brand_reply: Sorry you're having trouble at checkout. Please DM us the details and we'll help check what happened.

resolution: Collect order number and compare the received item with the order record.
brand_reply: Sorry about the mix-up. Please DM us your order number and we'll look into the incorrect item.

customer: Part of my order is missing.
resolution: Collect order number and identify the missing item.
brand_reply: Sorry something is missing. Please send your order number by DM and we'll check the order details.

customer: Please cancel my order before it ships.
resolution: Collect order number and verify whether cancellation is still possible.
brand_reply: We can check whether the order can still be cancelled. Please DM us your order number.

customer: How do I cancel this order?
resolution: Collect order number and check order status before confirming cancellation.
brand_reply: Please send us your order number by DM and we'll check the cancellation options.

customer: I can't log into my account.
resolution: Ask for non-sensitive account details and guide the customer through account recovery.
brand_reply: Sorry you're having trouble signing in. Please DM us and we'll help with account access.

customer: My account password reset isn't working.
resolution: Guide through password recovery without requesting the password itself.
brand_reply: We can help with that. Please DM us and we'll help you with the password reset process.

customer: Do you have any discount codes right now?
resolution: Share only promotions that are supported by current brand information.
brand_reply: Please check our current offers for available promotions. If you have a specific code, send it to us and we can help check it.

customer: Is there a promo for new customers?
resolution: Provide currently verified promotion information; do not invent a discount.
brand_reply: We'd be happy to help check the current offers. Send us the details by DM if you need help with a specific promotion.

resolution: Acknowledge frustration and invite the customer to provide details.
brand_reply: We're sorry to hear that. Please tell us what went wrong so we can look into it.

customer: Can someone help me with something about my order?
resolution: Ask a clarifying question rather than guessing the issue.
brand_reply: Of course. Please tell us a little more about the issue with your order and we'll help.
